g.title: kba_integrated_agent_architecture
g.text: Keystone Business Agents — one natural-language request, two execution shapes
Generated 2026-07-20 • numbered arrows show request order • context staging can feed either path • graph branch derived from 20 compiled nodes / 72 compiled edges

g.title: cluster_context_agents
g.text: OPTIONAL READ / CONTEXT STAGING — invoked only when the request needs evidence

g.title: cluster_graph
g.text: B2 — WORKITEM / LANGGRAPH RUNTIME — stateful or multi-owner

g.title: cluster_integrations
g.text: C — TOOLS, PROVIDERS, AND VERIFIED STATE

g.title: payload
g.text: Raw ask + bounded thread + saved work identity

g.title: orchestrator
g.text: Interpret the goal, likely owner, assumptions, and next safe action
An agent mention is routing advice—not authority

g.title: context_resolution
g.text: Infer safe defaults • retrieve bounded context

g.title: context_catalog
g.text: Airtable Context Agent — Base, table, field, and record evidence
Google Workspace Context Agent — Drive, Docs, and Sheets evidence
Zotero Context Agent — Library, collection, and item evidence
RSS Context Agent — Feed and article evidence
Preprints Context Agent — Preprint and article evidence
Selected by meaning; stage evidence only

g.title: direct_owner
g.text: Direct specialist, or KNI Chief of Staff Agent

g.text: source refs • schema • exact object identity

g.title: graph_context
g.text: Stage only the evidence the request needs

g.title: graph_approval
g.text: Pause at the exact gated action
